item.title: Vietnam: Financial Industry Fast-Tracks AI Adoption, Integration
item.description: Vietnam’s financial institutions are accelerating AI adoption and cloud modernisation to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen cybersecurity, improve resilience and deliver more personalised digital banking.

item.title: Singapore: Science-Policy Integration in Global AI Governance
item.description: Singapore underscored the importance of science-led, internationally coordinated AI governance, calling for interoperable frameworks, operational standards and inclusive capacity building to ensure AI benefits humanity responsibly.

item.title: Singapore: Practical Testing Frameworks for Responsible AI
item.description: Minister Josephine Teo outlined Singapore’s approach to bridging the gap between AI safety research and practical deployment, ensuring SMEs and organisations can adopt AI with built-in safeguards and assurance.

item.title: Malaysia: Technology, Skills, Innovation Advance Productivity
item.description: Malaysia is accelerating productivity growth by integrating digital technologies, advanced manufacturing and workforce development to strengthen innovation, efficiency and competitiveness across high-tech industries.

item.title: India: Human-Centric, Inclusive AI Takes Centre Stage at Summit
item.description: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 highlighted human-centric and inclusive AI, focusing on practical applications, workforce readiness and responsible governance for societal and economic benefit.

item.title: Australia: UNSW Harnesses AI to Tackle Ovarian Cancer
item.description: UNSW Sydney is applying advanced AI and integrated biomedical data from over 15,000 international ovarian cancer cases to improve survival predictions, personalise treatment strategies and guide clinical decisions.

item.title: The Philippines: Digital Banking Empowers Northern Negros Students
item.description: The Cash‑Lite Campus Programme in Northern Negros is equipping over 2,000 students with digital banking tools to promote financial literacy, secure transactions and cash‑lite campus operations.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Advances Intelligent Transport Solutions
item.description: Hong Kong Polytechnic University received HK$18.6 million from the Smart Traffic Fund to advance AI-driven logistics, wearable driver monitoring and bus emergency braking technologies for safer, more efficient urban transport.

item.title: Vietnam Strengthens AI Oversight as Banks Scale Digital Services
item.description: The State Bank of Vietnam is tightening AI regulations in banking, now requiring prior explicit customer notification, transparent disclosure and human oversight to ensure ethical, safe and responsible AI use.

item.title: Singapore’s Model for Safe and Responsible AI Adoption
item.description: Singapore translates AI safety research into practical laws, standards and comprehensive, internationally recognised frameworks, balancing innovation with safeguards to enable responsible and sustainable AI adoption regionally and globally.
